digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow and plan review modules
propositions: Nine modules are at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC cap, blocking feature work that requires threading provider_provenance through finalize_verdict call sites
gate_dispatch.py at 799 LOC has only 1 line of headroom, making it impossible to land the minimal three-line change required by story 343b gap-5 without structural changes
plan_review_recovery.py cluster (STEP constants, recovery functions, metrics) can be extracted as ~323 LOC into a new module, leaving gate_dispatch.py at ~527 LOC with 271 lines of headroom
context_assembly.py cluster (assemble_context, _assemble_cache, related helpers) can be extracted as ~194 LOC from orchestrator.py, leaving it at ~646 LOC with 154 lines of headroom
extracted modules must be re-imported into origin files to preserve zero test edits and maintain monkeypatching resolution, following precedent from 2682 and 3a98
no test file should be modified and the test count should remain stable (or increase with new seam tests only), verified by comparing collected test IDs across pre-split and post-split runs
